items.title: Check your passport
items.detail: Look at the expiry date. Your name's spelling must match on every document.

items.title: Marksheets and transcripts
items.detail: School and graduation marksheets, with scanned copies of all of them in one folder.

items.title: Test scores
items.detail: IELTS, TOEFL, PTE or GRE, whichever you took, save the score report.

items.title: Updated CV
items.detail: Projects, internships and achievements. One page, clean and simple.

youtube.title: Get these documents ready before you apply abroad
youtube.description:
Before you start your application, get these 4 things ready: your passport, marksheets and transcripts, test score reports, and an updated CV.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. You contact us, we never contact you first.
